item.title: These El Paso Spots Are Perfect for Unwinding

item.title: Sod Poodles Announce New Soddies Value Meal Deals for 2026.
item.description: Spring is officially here, and that means baseball is back in Amarillo! This season, the Sod Poodles are making it easier to enjoy the game with new Soddies Value Meal Deals. Check out the five new ways to bundle and save at Hodgetown.

item.description: If your Amarillo bucket list is just Cadillac Ranch and a 72oz steak, you are missing out. Here are 7 things locals should experience.

item.title: Splash Pads Set To Refresh Lubbock's Summer With Fun At Mae Simmons, Maxey, And Rodgers Park
item.description: With summer heat hitting Lubbock, residents are counting down to splash pad openings. Mae Simmons, Maxey, and Rodgers Parks will soon be the places to cool off.

item.title: Things You Only See in Lubbock (And Somehow Think Are Normal)
item.description: Life in Lubbock is full of surprises, from horses at the store to Ghostbusters cars and mariachi bands, making the ordinary feel wonderfully quirky.
